text: Gold dropped about 3.3% to near $3,723 an ounce, its lowest in about 14 months, after the Fed minutes and Governor Waller's comments kept a December rate hike firmly in view.
Silver fell about 5% to under $45, pushing the gold/silver ratio up to about 82.8; SLV closed down 4.6% and the 2x AGQ down 9.3%.
Gold miners fell harder than gold: GDX lost 6.0% to $74.82 and the 3x GDXU about 18%.
The Fed minutes showed almost all officials expect further rate increases; futures put the chance of a December hike near 95%.
The 10-year Treasury yield slipped almost 4 bp to about 5.06%, while the 2-year held near 4.80%.
The Nasdaq rose 0.4% and QQQ 0.4%, while the S&P 500 fell 0.2% for a fifth straight loss and the Dow dropped 561 points as Nvidia fell after its results.
The VIX eased 3.5% to 24.56, ending a four-day rise but staying above 20.
